images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: website capability photograph for ROBOTIC ELECTRONICS SERIAL PRODUCTION. Create one very high quality realistic industrial photograph, wide 16:9, 1792x1024 or larger. A compact modern electronics assembly line with THREE clearly recognizable six-axis industrial robotic arms arranged in sequence alongside a precision conveyor carrying a repeated series of identical small circuit boards in ESD fixtures. The nearest robotic arm is performing selective soldering: at its wrist a slender soldering iron tip touches an actual PCB pad, with a fine solder-wire feeder approaching the same joint. The second arm further down the line places or transfers a board. The third arm belongs to a test/inspection station. All arms have plausible articulated joints, real cable dress packs and functional end effectors. Soldering is delicate, no sparks, no flames, no welding torch, no dramatic smoke. Clean safety-glazed manufacturing cells, brushed metal conveyor, neutral white/grey and restrained navy palette, small warm status lights. Use a three-quarter view down the line, robots visible as the main subject, repeating boards visible in the foreground. Crisp engineering detail and high depth of field; professional factory photography, no futuristic fantasy, no people, no logos, no text or readable screens. This is an illustrative concept of a PLANNED facility, not a documentary photo of an existing company factory. No text on the image. Must remain legible when cropped to a 16:9 website card.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium avionics website POWER ELECTRONICS capability photo, wide 16:9, 1792x1024 or larger. Create one exceptionally crisp industrial macro photograph of a GENERIC integrated high-current DC power conversion stage. Show a close detail, not a whole product: thick flat copper busbars bolted to black rectangular power semiconductor modules, a low-profile planar magnetic component and several orderly compact power components mounted together on a dark blue circuit substrate above a restrained machined aluminum cooling base. The assembly continues out of frame. The broad copper current paths, robust terminals and thermal engineering should be visually obvious, clearly distinct from a digital microprocessor PCB. No large toroidal coil, no loose components arranged on a table, no forest of tall capacitors, no giant heatsink, no enclosure, no consumer charger, no complete branded device. Three-quarter low overhead view, balanced simple composition, believable fasteners and joins, rich realistic copper and matte black against cool navy. Soft precise studio lighting, high depth of field, highly detailed edge definition, physically plausible scale. No neon, no lightning effects, no glow, no labels, no text, no logos, no people. Generic illustrative engineering detail; do not imply an actual company product.
